sections.content: Modern frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte, Angular) still emit HTML — JSX/templating is HTML plus expressions. Understanding raw HTML transfers directly.
Key differences: the framework owns the DOM and re-renders on state change, attributes map to properties (className in React), and hydration attaches behavior to server-rendered HTML.
Key points: learn HTML first — frameworks assume it, accessibility still applies, and view-source shows the final markup.
